info.name: Zest equity public api Authentication API
Exchange a JWT assertion for an access token

items.docs: OAuth 2.0 JWT-Bearer assertion grant. Submit `grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer` plus a signed JWT `assertion`. Returns a short-lived bearer access token used for subsequent partner API calls.
Returns metadata about the bearer token currently presented in the Authorization header. Useful for verifying that a token corresponds to the expected partner application.
